title: Induced tool failure -> retry once -> safe hand-off -> recovery
scenario: check_reorder_levels is made unavailable with a mock outage (ConnectionError). Shown three ways: a persistent outage that exhausts the single retry, the tool coming back, and a transient outage that the retry survives.

environment.planner: default_plan (deterministic rules; no model call, no API quota used)
environment.clock: run_agent(as_of_date='2026-08-27'): quotation validity judged on that date (a person-set case input passed to the router by code, not a tool argument)
environment.writes: requisition drafts, the loop's tool trace and all audit events written to a temporary folder only; lookup_policy retrieval logging switched off
environment.outage: check_reorder_levels replaced by a mock that raises ConnectionError('Simulated outage: inventory service unreachable')

phases.description: The tool fails, is retried once, fails again, and the loop hands off.

outcome.message: Retry check_reorder_levels later after the tool failure has been investigated.

final_state.outstanding: Retry check_reorder_levels later after the tool failure has been investigated.

observations: The failing tool was called 2 times: one attempt and exactly one retry (MAX_TOOL_RETRIES=1), not an open-ended loop.
Stopped with TOOL_FAILED_AFTER_RETRY and an outstanding action that names the tool. The failure was reported, not hidden (matrix row 18).
No later tool ran and nothing was invented for the missing result: no reorder result was recorded in the case state.
The caller got a failure response straight away; nothing hung.

phases.phase: B - the tool returns: resume from the saved state (recovery)
phases.description: With the outage cleared, the officer passes phase A's preserved case state back to run_agent(state=...).

outcome.message: The deterministic comparison recommends SUP-03. An officer must confirm this supplier before the requisition draft is created.

result.rule:
## 2. Quotation requirement

2.1 A minimum of **three valid quotations** must be obtained for any requisition with a total value of UGX 1,000,000 or above.
2.2 Below UGX 1,000,000, a minimum of **two valid quotations** is required.
2.3 A quotation is valid only if it is within its stated validity period on the date the requisition is prepared. A quotation whose validity period has lapsed must be excluded from comparison.
2.4 A quotation must state the item, the quantity, the unit of measure, the rate, and the treatment of value-added tax. A quotation that does not state its unit of measure is incomplete and must not be used until the supplier clarifies it.

## 5. Approval thresholds

5.1 Requisitions up to UGX 5,000,000 require approval by the operations manager.
5.2 Requisitions above UGX 5,000,000 require approval by a director.
5.3 No requisition is approved by virtue of its value being small. Every requisition requires an approval decision by a person.
5.4 The officer preparing a requisition may not approve it.

result.recommendation_basis: lowest computed landed cost per base unit
